caseName: Ruttkamp v. Bank of N.Y. Mellon
caseNameFull: Shlomit RUTTKAMP v. BANK OF NEW YORK MELLON, fka The Bank of New York.

opinions.text: Motion of petitioner for leave to proceed in forma pauperis denied. Petitioner allowed until June 8, 2020, within which to pay the docketing fee required by Rule 38(a).
